notes.title: Final 24 Hours!
notes.notes:
Tiny Heroes! This is it! The last 24 hours of the campaign! As always we appreciate your support and passion to help us make the best game possible!

[b]Does it Blend[/b]
Just a reminder that this campaign is being run parallel to one on Campfire for Japanese backers. The TOTAL of BOTH campaigns will be used to calculate the amount raised towards clearing stretch goals, which means you’ve revealed our “Animated Toy Companions” stretch goal! What do we mean by animated toy companions?
